blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) said that they are looking into the cases handled by Basilan Regional Trial Court (RTC) Presiding Judge Joseph Wee Sit to investigate the possible motive for his death. Sit, presiding judge of the RTC Branch 2 in Isabela City, was shot and killed by two unidentified men at Zamboanga City early Thursday. PNP Brig. Gen. Allen Rae Co said that they are investigating all possible reasons behind the incident, including work-related feuds. READ: Basilan RTC judge killed in Zamboanga City ambush “He’s a judge.
